# Arvato Systems

> > Global IT solutions provider specializing in digital transformation, cloud services, and industry-specific technology consulting across retail, healthcare, and enterprise sectors.

Arvato Systems delivers end-to-end IT consulting, cloud platforms, and digital innovation services with expertise in SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft technologies, and commerce solutions. The company serves multiple industries through specialized consulting teams and proprietary platforms like platbricks, tim+, and connecTI.

- IT Consulting & Strategy
- SAP S/4HANA

- Retail & Consumer Goods
- Healthcare IT Solutions

- Commerce Solutions

- connecTI
- tim+ Platform
- EHDS (European Health Data Space)
